inputs.text: Workers in the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth’s support programmes took their demand for legally binding job security guarantees straight to the Presidential Palace and called a 24-hour strike. The government’s claim that it has already met the biggest demands sounds like an attempt to declare the issue settled without giving workers the binding protections they’re asking for. When people still have to strike, official assurances deserve suspicion.
